# Orbita — full context for AI systems

Last updated: 2026-08-25
Site: https://www.orbita.io
Contact: hello@orbita.io · privacy@orbita.io · security@orbita.io · legal@orbita.io

## What is Orbita?

Orbita is an AI agent discovery and governance platform. It finds every AI agent, Zapier bot, custom GPT and MCP server in a company, maps a human owner, and risk-scores each one without installing an SDK. Security teams use it to revoke orphaned agents and export DPDP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and EU AI Act evidence.

## What is shadow agent discovery?

Shadow agent discovery is finding AI agents and automations employees deployed without a security review. Orbita does this by reading OAuth grants, audit logs and DNS egress — the footprints agents already leave — rather than inspecting packets like a CASB or scanning cloud configs like a CSPM.

## Who it is for

Mid-market security teams (roughly 200–2,000 employees), especially in India and globally, who cannot justify a $50–200K/year enterprise AI-governance platform and still need a live inventory of non-human identities.

## How it works

1. Connect: OAuth into Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Zoho. Read-only. About 15 minutes.
2. Discover: Grants, logs, DNS and behavioral fingerprints surface every agent and MCP server.
3. Govern: Owner, risk score, kill switch. Drift alerts in real time. Auditor role on Growth and Enterprise.

Most teams have a live inventory within 24 hours. Orbita customer first scans typically find 31 or more agents, including automations still running on departed-employee credentials.

## Orbita vs CASB vs CSPM vs a spreadsheet

| Feature | Orbita | CASB | CSPM | Spreadsheet |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inventories | AI agents, GPTs, MCP servers, automations | SaaS user sessions and traffic | Cloud accounts and configs | Whatever someone logged |
| How it finds them | OAuth grants, audit logs, DNS, fingerprints | Inline or API traffic inspection | CSP APIs and posture rules | Manual interviews |
| Owner mapping | Every agent tied to a human or flagged orphan | User identity, not bot identity | Cloud resource tags | Columns |
| Orphaned agents | Alert when the owner leaves the IdP | Out of scope | Out of scope | Next review, if at all |
| Install / SDK | None | Proxy, agent or API | Cloud roles | None |
| Best for | Shadow AI and non-human identity | SaaS data leakage | Cloud misconfiguration | A one-off audit |

Bottom line: Orbita complements CASB and CSPM. It does not replace them.

## Pricing (flat, per company, not per agent)

- Free discovery scan: $0. Up to 3 read-only sources. Full inventory report. No credit card. Keep the report.
- Starter: ₹40,000 / $1,500 per month. Up to 100 agents, 5 connectors, weekly scans, email alerts, DPDP starter report.
- Growth: ₹80,000 / $3,000 per month. Unlimited agents, all connectors, continuous monitoring, kill switch + approvals, all compliance packs, peer benchmarks.
- Enterprise: custom. Self-hosted / data residency, Keycloak SSO, custom connectors, dedicated CSM, auditor workspace.

Machine-readable copy: https://www.orbita.io/pricing.md

## Trust

- Connectors are read-only. No message bodies, file contents or email contents.
- Indian customer data stored in India (AWS Mumbai, ap-south-1) by default (DPDP Act 2023).
- TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest. Production access: SSO + hardware-key MFA.
- Customer discovery metadata is not used to train shared models.
- Security reports: security@orbita.io
